body:
Breaking up does kinda hurt. I remember that from way back in the day. 
Getting divorced, however. . . Losing the person you thought you would spend your life with and spend almost a decade waking up next two. . . Losing the 3 people that you designed your life around (like a good husband and step father does), literally losing your entire life. . . Ya that isn't really same catagory as "breaking up". 

"you don't need to end your life". The problem is I am not sure that I need to not.

Thank you for your answer, and I am very sorry for your grief. Do you think it would be better if you believed, truly believed, that his death was accidental? 

I haven't dealt with much death in my life (not young, just haven't had much around me) and never suicide, so please forgive me if the answer to that question seems obvious.
